name.es: RCBO (diferencial con proteccion de sobrecorriente integrada)

description.en: Combined residual current and overcurrent device for a single final circuit. Protects against both overcurrent and earth leakage in one module.
description.es: Equipo combinado de corriente residual y sobrecorriente para un circuito final. Protege contra sobrecorriente y fuga a tierra en un solo modulo.

when_to_use.en: Single final circuit that needs both overcurrent and RCD protection in a small space (typical)
when_to_use.es: Circuito final unico que requiere sobrecorriente y diferencial en poco espacio (typical)

when_not_to_use.en: Several circuits needing RCD protection: a common RCCB with MCBs may be more economical (typical)
when_not_to_use.es: Varios circuitos que requieren diferencial: un RCCB comun con MCB puede ser mas economico (typical)
